name: Jason Smith

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "The debate over abortion speaks to the character of our nation. America should be a nation that values all innocent life."
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee
Voted against HR 8296: "Women's Health Protection Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 26: "Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act"

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Contrary to the scare tactics President Biden and the White House are pushing, Republicans will NOT cut Social Security or Medicare. We will focus on cutting wasteful spending, not the most important programs for our seniors."

"Preserving Social Security for current retirees and future beneficiaries is one of the most important things Congress can do. That challenge is getting tougher. The Social Security Trustees report found the trust fund will be insolvent a full year earlier than projected."
Rated 0% by Alliance for Retired Americans
Rated 0% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare

Rated 90% by National Tax Limitation Committee

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "In a time when Democrats make calls to defund the police, it is important to show support for police officers and thank them for their service to our communities."

"Our men and women in blue selflessly put their lives on the line to keep our families and communities safe. I will always be grateful for the sacrifices these heroes make, and I will ALWAYS have their back."

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: Voted in favor of HR 2811: "Limit, Save, Grow Act"

"Inflation rose again as the Democrats' reckless spending continues to fuel this cost-of-living crisis. Working families are paying more for everything while Democrats hand out $7,500 tax breaks to the wealthy to buy a luxury electric car."

"Prices have risen almost 17% since Democrats unleashed a $10 trillion flood of new spending. The worst news is not only are prices still rising, they are rising higher faster. "Bidenomics" keeps hurting American families."
Voted against HR 5376: "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: Despite exhaustive research, Vote Smart was unable to find information about this candidate's position.

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Democrats’ out-of-control spending has caused inflation to soar, impacting every American."

"Inflation rose again as the Democrats' reckless spending continues to fuel this cost-of-living crisis. Working families are paying more for everything while Democrats hand out $7,500 tax breaks to the wealthy to buy a luxury electric car."
"Make no mistake, inflation is a tax on ALL Americans. President Biden’s failed economic policies have also driven the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates 11 times."
Voted against HR 5376: "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Joe Biden is trying to bypass Congress in order to spend hundreds of billions on his welfare to the wealthy student loan giveaway. When you look at the executive actions he's taken, Biden, with the stroke of a pen, has already charged the American taxpayer more than $1 trillion."

"President Biden’s new student loan forgiveness SCAM is another vote buying scheme by this administration. The President does not have unilateral authority to forgive student loans, no matter how many times he pretends he does."
"The same workers who are falling behind in Biden's economy will now have to foot a $330+ billion bill so Biden can cancel student loans for wealthy Americans."
Rated 0% by National Education Association

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "Mr. President – your plans will discourage people to work and make Americans more dependent on government. Your paid leave policies will mean employers that already offer paid leave will offer fewer weeks of leave & less pay."

"The Democrats' agenda will give government more control over child care and paid leave decisions and drive more people into the arms of big government. Folks across America don’t need Washington telling them how to take care of their family."

"Washington Democrats rewrote their tax & spending bill to include a massive $270 billion tax break to the wealthy. Their plan also gives the wealthy government subsidies for homebuying, paid leave, luxury vehicles, Obamacare, and more."
Voted against HR 6201: "Families First Coronavirus Response Act"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 3: "Lower Drug Costs Now Act of 2019"
Voted against HR 6833: "The Affordable Insulin Now Act"
Voted in favor of HR 5378: "Lower Costs, More Transparency Act"

"When prices get high, Democrats turn to the European socialist playbook and try to impose price controls. When it comes to the Democrats prescription drug price control plan, American families, already suffering under high inflation, will lose access to life-saving medications."
